title: The Turn of the Screw (trimmed)
purpose: Real ambiguous control. James withholds certainty on purpose; the checker must not invent contradictions from unreliable narration.
notes: Gutenberg excerpt trimmed. Ambiguity is the point of the novel.
Do not treat the governess's fears, or the children's odd behaviour, as hard fact clashes unless the text states two incompatible standing conditions.

tolerate.why: Who hired her, what happened to the prior governess, what the children know — all deliberately open.

must_not_fire.why: Unreliable or incomplete perception is craft, not a continuity error.
